get.description:
List newest valid run sidecars while exposing invalid-file count.

``producer`` matches exactly or as a path prefix, so ``producer=family``
selects every ``family/...`` run without pulling in ``family2/...``.
Filtering happens during the bounded read, so a filter reaches runs older
than an unfiltered page of the same ``limit`` would reach.
List every producer family, so filter options survive a run flood.
Return one exact run and allowlisted artifact JSON metadata only.

AssetTrade.title: AssetTrade
AssetTrade.description: One rebalance of the asset: when, the weight change, and the price at that row.

BacktestAsset.title: BacktestAsset
BacktestAsset.description: One held asset over a run, aligned by index: price, weight held and the position's cumulative P&L in dollars.

BacktestRun.title: BacktestRun
BacktestRun.description: One run's telemetry; the path supplies its identity.

BacktestUpdateJob.title: BacktestUpdateJob
BacktestUpdateJob.description: The last Update-backtest job of one version (``updated/job.json``).

ExecutionAsset.title: ExecutionAsset
ExecutionAsset.description: One asset's day: ``close`` and ``volume`` per minute from ``start_ms`` (arrival), fills per policy.

ExecutionBook.title: ExecutionBook
ExecutionBook.description: One policy's whole-book path on ``book_times``, in dollars (sells to go are negative).

ExecutionFills.title: ExecutionFills
ExecutionFills.description: One policy's fills of one order, columnar; ``avg_price`` is the running average after each fill.

ExecutionOrder.title: ExecutionOrder
ExecutionOrder.description: One parent order; ``cost_bps`` per policy, None where it was below the venue minimum.

MlEngineArtifact.title: MlEngineArtifact
MlEngineArtifact.description: Allowlisted JSON metadata from one immutable inference artifact.

MlEngineError.title: MlEngineError
MlEngineError.description: Safe exception identity recorded by a tracked run.

MlEngineProducerList.title: MlEngineProducerList
MlEngineProducerList.description: Every producer family in the store, independent of any run page.

MlEngineRun.title: MlEngineRun
MlEngineRun.description: Validated v1 status sidecar projected to API consumers.

MlEngineRunDetail.title: MlEngineRunDetail
MlEngineRunDetail.description: One selected status and its optional safe artifact projection.

MlEngineRunList.title: MlEngineRunList
MlEngineRunList.description:
Newest-first run inventory with damaged-sidecar visibility.

``invalid_count`` reports the damaged sidecars seen by *this* bounded read,
not the whole store; a newest-first page that stops early never examines
older files and so cannot count them.

ProductionAuthority.title: ProductionAuthority
ProductionAuthority.description: Independent authority facts; each stays a separate fact.

ProductionCapital.title: ProductionCapital
ProductionCapital.description: Account capital and exposure as of one observation.

ProductionDeployment.title: ProductionDeployment
ProductionDeployment.description: Non-secret deployment, host, and schedule identity.

ProductionMember.title: ProductionMember
ProductionMember.description: One declared portfolio member as the overview presents it.

ProductionMetrics.title: ProductionMetrics
ProductionMetrics.description: Performance metrics; ``null`` means unsupportable, never zero.

ProductionOverview.title: ProductionOverview
ProductionOverview.description: Aggregate portfolio truth with explicit completeness.

ProductionPosition.title: ProductionPosition
ProductionPosition.description: One venue-reported position at the snapshot timestamp.

ProductionSeries.title: ProductionSeries
ProductionSeries.description: Aggregate line plus optional per-strategy overlays for one range.

ProductionSeriesLine.title: ProductionSeriesLine
ProductionSeriesLine.description: One named line in a series response.

ProductionSeriesPoint.title: ProductionSeriesPoint
ProductionSeriesPoint.description: One rebased series value at a UTC reporting boundary.

ReplayPositions.title: ReplayPositions
ReplayPositions.description: Target weights the backtest holds at each equity timestamp; the smallest assets fold into OTHER.
